description: This file defines a Settings class that loads and manages application configuration from environment variables, including paths, environment modes, database credentials, and a flag for seeding the database. It also provides utility to ensure media directories exist and creates a singleton instance for global access.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration loaded from environment variables, including media root, environment mode, database credentials, and seed flag, with methods to initialize settings and ensure necessary directories exist.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes a Settings object by loading environment variables, setting default paths, environment mode, seed flag, and database credentials.

methods.name: None ensure_media_dirs(self)
methods.description: Creates the media root and subdirectories ('videos', 'subtitles') if they do not exist.
